stages.sub: How a government can use interest rates to move its exchange rate.

steps.q: A UK bank account suddenly pays 6% interest while similar accounts abroad pay 1%. Where will short-term savers around the world want to move their money?
steps.right: Into the UK, chasing the higher return
steps.wrong: Away from the UK, avoiding the change
steps.hint: Savers move cash quickly to wherever it earns most, they are not tied to one country.

steps.q: A government wants its currency to appreciate. Given that raising interest rates attracts hot money and pushes up demand for the currency, what tool could it use on purpose?
steps.right: Raise domestic interest rates to attract inflows
